newsitem.title: USA: Republic acquires 3 solid waste companies.
newsitem.headline: Republic acquires 3 solid waste companies.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc announced Wednesday it has closed deals to acquire three solid waste companies, paying $79 million in common stock.
The new acquisitions will add about $42 million of annual revenue, the Fort Lauderdale, Fla.,-based conglomerate said.
The companies acquired were Meyer Waste Systems Inc, of Chesterton, Ind.; Monarch Environmental Inc, of Bowling Green, Ky., and Rainbow Industries Inc, of Chantilly, Va.
Republic operates units in the solid waste, automotive, electronic security and advertising industries.
